Ava M.: Quick sync on Cloud Adapter co-marketing: need launch post, benchmark callout, joint webinar, and inbound routing. Target publish week 4/10. Who takes what?

Tom P.: I can run webinar ops + partner comms. Proposed format: 15m demo, 20m product talk, 10m Q&A. Need 2 benchmark slides (latency + cost).

Ravi S.: I9ll draft the launch post + benchmark narrative. @eng-ml can you drop p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec for 4k context runs? Need numbers by 3/25.

Jules R.: I9ll do inbound routing. Basic rules: partner form -> sales.connectors + notify #sales-connector-leads; webinar regs -> marketing-ops webhook. Will add opt-in flag and spam honeypot.

MarketplaceBot: Draft partner listing uploaded: https://portal.internal/partners/cloud-adapter/draft (access: marketing, partnerships)

Ava M.: Action items: Ravi blog + bench by 2026-03-28; Tom webinar runbook + slides by 2026-03-30; Jules routing spec + webhook test by 2026-03-29. Sync 2026-03-24 10:00 PT (30m).

Tom P.: Promo tracking: utm_source=cloud-adapter&utm_medium=co-marketing&utm_campaign=adapter_launch. Use hidden partner field.

Ravi S.: Will include 2 headline variants and a social-sized benchmark image. I9ll mock partner quote to speed approvals.

Jules R.: Will post webhook test result to #marketing-ops and attach replay. Security sign-off required.

Ava M.: Great. I9ll create tasks and loop in Legal + Sales Ops.
